fields.name: ParameterMapAttributeBase property mapping attribute
fields.contract: ParameterMapAttributeBase is an abstract property attribute. Each instance supplies one property-to-database mapping: an implementation must decide whether a candidate CLR type is supported and must contribute the expressions needed for input parameters, output-parameter setup, output-value reading, and data-reader value reading. The base surface exposes the mapping names, provider-specific type code and optional record-identifier role to those operations. Of the six base properties, ParameterName, ColumnName and SqlTypeName are virtual and may be overridden by a derived provider attribute; Name, SqlType and IsRecordIdentifier are fixed once set by the base constructor and cannot be overridden.
